collection.title: VW Golf Plus 2005 to 2009 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A VW Golf Plus 2005 to 2009 model requires a 28" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Side Pin arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also have the rear blade for this Golf Plus, simply click the Rear Blades tab below.
